title: Dave Altman connects the transient dates to the Washington flap

tellings.quote: And then my colleague, Dave Altman, who is the manager media manager for WASCO, he said, "Do you know what happens on or what happened on 19th of July, 1952?"

plain: The astronomer Beatriz Villarroel says that dates in her data when brief, unexplained points of light appeared in the sky lined up with the wave of UFO sightings over Washington, D.C. in July 1952. She credits the link to a colleague, Dave Altman, the media manager for her project, which she calls WASCO, who asked her: "Do you know what happens on or what happened on 19th of July, 1952?" If it holds, her sky records would match a famous run of sightings over the US capital.
